apps.name: Rigel
apps.subtitle: Play media formats iOS does not natively support.
apps.localizedDescription: Rigel is an iOS media player for HTTP(S) links, local files, HLS, Jellyfin, and formats such as MKV, WebM, AVI, MPEG-TS, and FLV. It can cast to DLNA, Kodi, Roku, and AirPlay devices, and can act as a UPnP renderer.

permissions.usageDescription: Rigel discovers and connects to media devices on your local network.
Rigel continues audio playback while the app is in the background.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Rigel discovers TVs on your local network (DLNA, Roku).
